zh.text: 名義利率和實質利率

en.text: The expected inflation rate and the real rate of interest are 10% and 4% respectively. If the actual inflation rate turns out to be 9% only, the cost of holding cash is ______ and the real rate of return on holding cash is ______.

zh.text: 預期通脹率與實質利率分別為 10% 及 4%。若實際通脹率只有 9%，持有現金的成本是 ______，而持有現金的實質回報率是 ______。
香港高級程度會考 1999 卷二 第 18 題

en.text: The nominal interest rate and the expected inflation rate are 10% and 7% respectively. If the actual inflation rate turns out to be 12%, then the realized real rate of interest will be ______ and the real rate of return on holding cash will be ______.

zh.text: 名義利率與預期通脹率分別為 10% 及 7%。若實際通脹率為 12%，則實現的實質利率是 ______，而持有現金的實質回報率是 ______。
香港高級程度會考 2002 卷二 第 22 題
當出現通貨緊縮時，

en.text: the real interest rate will be negative.

zh.text: 實質利率會是負數。

en.text: the nominal interest rate will be negative.

zh.text: 名義利率會是負數。

en.text: the real interest rate will be higher than the nominal interest rate.

zh.text: 實質利率會高於名義利率。
以上皆是。
香港高級程度會考 2005 卷二 第 22 題

en.text: If the nominal interest rate on one-year bond is 8% and the expected inflation rate is 3%, the nominal rate of return and the expected real rate of return of holding money are ______ and ______ respectively.

zh.text: 若一年期債券的名義利率是 8%，而預期通脹率是 3%，持有貨幣的名義回報率與預期實質回報率分別是 ______ 及 ______。
香港高級程度會考 2006 卷二 第 8 題

en.text: The real interest rate will be higher than the nominal interest rate if

zh.text: 在下列哪種情況下，實質利率會高於名義利率？

en.text: the actual inflation rate is lower than the expected inflation rate.

zh.text: 實際通脹率低於預期通脹率。

en.text: the expected inflation rate is falling.

zh.text: 預期通脹率正在下降。

en.text: the nominal interest rate is falling.

zh.text: 名義利率正在下降。

en.text: the price level is expected to fall.

zh.text: 預期物價水平會下降。
香港高級程度會考 2006 卷二 第 21 題

en.text: Suppose the nominal interest rate on a one-year bond is 3% and the expected deflation rate is 2%. However, the general price level turns out to rise by 3%. The nominal rate of return and the actual real rate of return of holding the bond are __________ and __________ respectively.

zh.text: 假設一年期債券的名義利率是 3%，預期通貨緊縮率是 2%。然而，一般物價水平結果上升了 3%。持有該債券的名義回報率及實際實質回報率分別是 __________ 及 __________。
香港高級程度會考 2010 卷二 第 19 題

en.text: If the nominal interest rate on a one-year bond is 10% and the expected inflation rate is 2%, the nominal rate of return and the expected cost of holding cash are ________ and ________ respectively.

zh.text: 若一年期債券的名義利率是 10%，而預期通脹率是 2%，持有現金的名義回報率與預期成本分別是 ________ 及 ________。
香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 28 題

en.text: When the nominal interest rate is higher than the real interest rate, the expected inflation rate must be

zh.text: 當名義利率高於實質利率，預期通脹率必定
是正數。
是負數。
在上升。
在下降。

en.text: The nominal interest rate of a one-year bond and the expected inflation rate are 8% and 3% respectively. If the actual inflation rate is 6%, then the actual real interest rate is _______ and the actual rate of return of holding cash is _______.

zh.text: 一年期債券的名義利率和預期通脹率分別是 8% 和 3%。若實際通脹率是 6%，則實際實質利率是 ________ 而持有現金的實際回報率是 ________。
香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 32 題

en.text: If the nominal interest rate is 5% and the expected inflation rate is 3%, the cost of holding money is ___________, the nominal return of holding money is ___________ and the expected real interest rate is ___________.

zh.text: 若名義利率是 5%，而預期通脹率是 3%，則持有貨幣的成本是 __________，持有貨幣的名義回報是 __________，而預期實質利率是 __________。
香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 31 題
細閱下圖。

en.text: The diagram shows that during the period from October 2014 to July 2015,

zh.text: 該圖顯示在 2014 年 10 月至 2015 年 7 月之間，
名義本地生產總值正在下跌。

en.text: the purchasing power of money was increasing.

zh.text: 貨幣的購買力正在上升。

en.text: the growth rate of real GDP was higher than that of nominal GDP.

zh.text: 實質本地生產總值的增長率高於名義本地生產總值的增長率。

en.text: the nominal interest rate was higher than the realised real interest rate.

zh.text: 名義利率高於已實現的實質利率。
香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 24 題

en.text: Assume that the real interest rate is 6% and the expected inflation rate is 3%. If the actual inflation rate is 5%, the cost of holding money will be ____________.

zh.text: 假設實質利率是 6%，預期通脹率是 3%。若實際通脹率是 5%，持有貨幣的成本會是 _____。
香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 34 題

en.text: In times of inflation, suppose the nominal interest rate of a bond is higher than the expected inflation rate. If the actual inflation rate turns out to be higher than the expected inflation rate,

zh.text: 在通脹的時期，假設某債券的名義利率高於預期通脹率。若實際通脹率高於預期通脹率，

en.text: the actual inflation rate will be higher than the nominal interest rate of the bond.

zh.text: 實際通脹率會高於該債券的名義利率。

en.text: the expected real rate of return of the bond will be greater than the actual real rate of return.

zh.text: 該債券的預期實質回報率會高於實際實質回報率。

en.text: the actual real rate of return of the bond may be negative.

zh.text: 該債券的實際實質回報率可能是負數。

en.text: the real rate of return of holding cash will be higher than zero.

zh.text: 持有現金的實質回報率會大於零。

en.text: Suppose the actual inflation rate and the nominal interest rate are -1% and 3% respectively. Which of the following statements are correct?

zh.text: 假設實際通脹率和名義利率分別是 -1% 和 3%。下列哪些陳述是正確的？

en.text: The cost of holding cash is 3%.

zh.text: 持有現金的成本是 3%。

en.text: The expected real interest rate is higher than the nominal interest rate.

zh.text: 預期實質利率高於名義利率。

en.text: The actual real rate of return on holding cash is 1%.

zh.text: 持有現金的實際實質回報率是 1%。

en.text: The nominal interest rate on a one-year deposit is 1% and the inflation rate is 3%. The cost of holding cash is ______ and the real rate of return of holding cash is ______.

zh.text: 一年期存款的名義利率是 1%，而通脹率是 3%。持有現金的成本是 ________ 而持有現金的實質回報率是 ________。

債券的名義利率
預期通脹率

en.text: Based on the above information, the ____ of holding money is 6%, and the expected real rate of return of holding ____ is -4%.

zh.text: 根據上述資料，持有貨幣的______是 6%，而持有______的預期實質回報率是 -4%。
成本 …… 貨幣
成本 …… 債券
名義回報率 …… 貨幣
名義回報率 …… 債券

en.text: Suppose the nominal interest rate remains constant. When the actual inflation rate is lower than the expected inflation rate, the actual real interest rate will be higher than the ___.

zh.text: 假設名義利率維持不變。當實際通脹率低於預期通脹率時，實際實質利率會高於 ___。
只有 (1)
預期實質利率
名義利率
實際通脹率

zh.text: 假設預期實質利率是 4%，預期通脹率是 6%。若實際通縮率是 5%，持有貨幣的成本會是 ______，而持有貨幣的實際實質回報率是 ______。
